about.title: About me
paragraphs: I am a computer science engineer at Wazuh. I work on SIEM, XDR, and intrusion detection systems. I graduated in computer engineering from the University of Granada with a focus on computing and intelligent systems.
I build skills through practice and take on tasks that stretch what I know. I stay disciplined about learning and put in the work on hard problems.
At university I built projects in deep learning, machine learning, data science, game development, cybersecurity, and web development. I work proactively and like to learn.

thesis.title: Thesis
thesis.description: Interactive 3D view of elliptic curves through the Hopf fibration. You can explore 18 torus shapes in lattice, wavy, and exotic groups. The app has 12 color modes, 6 materials, 3 animations, and full control of parameters. I built it with Three.js for my thesis on elliptic curve cryptography.

items.title: Running

items.title: Music

description: Architect and establish custom Security Operations Center (SOC) platforms for major enterprises, engineering SIEM, XDR, HIDS and NIDS solutions across on-prem and cloud infrastructures.
Core maintainer of Wazuh's public integrations repository (https://github.com/wazuh/integrations) and a recognized product expert supporting enterprise customers and the wider open-source community.
Engineered log ingestion pipelines processing over 250B events while maintaining detection accuracy and system stability at scale.
Cut client cloud infrastructure costs by up to 20% by migrating AWS EKS pods from ARM to AMD for equivalent multi-pod Wazuh environments at lower cost, plus right-sizing and workload tuning.
Resolved high-impact Wazuh issues for enterprise customers, significantly improving visibility, detection accuracy and system stability.
Advised on security hardening and anomaly detection tuning, reducing alert noise through thresholding, grouping and rule refinement.
Rollout and management of Wazuh, OpenSearch (Open Distro) and Elastic Stack across diverse client environments, optimizing each for peak efficiency.
Integrated cloud platforms into monitoring pipelines: Azure via Microsoft Graph API and AWS via SQS, CloudTrail and VPC Flow Logs.
Configured SSO and RBAC for enterprise identity providers (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace, LDAP).
Developed custom SCA policies aligned with compliance frameworks (PCI-DSS, CJIS, ISO 27001).
Configured Filebeat pipelines and syslog forwarding from agentless devices (Sophos, FortiGate, Cisco) using rsyslog and localfile configuration.
Redesigned default folder structure, managed volume mounts, resized filesystems and optimized disk usage.
Provided IT consulting and technical support across the organization.
Built a custom desktop app to streamline daily workflows.
Deployed MFA, endpoint protection, and anti-phishing controls.
Ran training sessions so users could adopt new systems and security rules.

items.details: Focus on computing and intelligent systems. Coursework includes AI, machine learning, networking, C++, Python, OOP, OpenGL, and cybersecurity. Honors in calculus, statistics, machine learning, and programming.
Final year abroad. Coursework includes computer vision, deep learning for medical imaging, cybersecurity, real-time operating systems in C, and cloud computing.

items.name: Potocolom Studio
items.description: Open source, real time generative image platform. You can generate images, enhance them, upscale them and can sketch on a canvas and a diffusion model paints over your strokes live, then one click hands the result to a heavier model for the final image. One AGPL codebase runs it both ways - self-hosted on your own GPU for free, or as a managed cloud with subscriptions.

items.name: Elliptic Curve Visualization
items.description: Interactive plot of elliptic curves (y² = x³ + ax + b) with adjustable parameters and zoom. Part of my thesis on elliptic curve cryptography.

items.name: Cypher - Encrypted Chat App
items.description: Encrypted chat app with end-to-end encryption, real-time messaging, and no metadata storage. It uses TLS, Signal-style protocols, and AES. Users stay anonymous by design.

items.name: Self-Hosted Nextcloud
items.description: Private file sync and storage on Docker and Traefik. Part of a homelab where I control my own data instead of using cloud drives.

items.name: Classifying Mushrooms
items.description: Supervised models that classify mushroom edibility from the UCI Secondary Mushroom dataset. Course project at the University of Granada.

items.name: AI for Ludo Game
items.description: Parchís variant with a deliberative AI agent. It uses MINIMAX and alpha-beta pruning to play against humans.

items.name: Visual Path Finding
items.description: Interactive demo of path-finding algorithms such as A* and Dijkstra. Built as a teaching aid for algorithm behavior.

items.name: Solar System Simulation
items.description: Python simulation of orbits, gravity, collisions, and asteroids. Built with pygame.

items.name: Pichola - Award-Winning Game
items.description: Game built in a 48-hour jam with Godot. Theme: start from nothing. You begin as an egg and collect others to unlock skills. Won Best Art.
